Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 4.2, 9; courts B/D/H. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7E24BZ6KPTB0B31FGSDB, bd-01M35A7C9MYCHFJD0XMVT7JRYW, bd-01M35A7CQVFV9PYPABKXH3624W, bd-01M35A7B6R63M4B10R3J3XBW54.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own composition of existing navigator, event/relationship/reading and media components into the second mockup. Keep source evidence kind/occurrence named and one Return-to-recall context. No duplicated inspector or film-specific mapping implementation.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Select a nonwinning scene alternative, inspect its supplied events/roles/context and exact annotation/media support, then return to the originating row/viewport.
2. Event inspection under scene-localized mapping explicitly retains scene grain; no event probability or point timing is manufactured.
3. Repeated occurrences, missing media, failed recalls and denied evidence remain usable/explicit in every component.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Keep source reading plus shared inspector without rich film composition; retain original mapping records.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Film] Link scene exploration to retained recall context and evidence
